units.source_text: 不如一开始就着眼于环境。

en.t: It would be better to focus on the environment from the very beginning.

units.source_text: 仅“变种多”这一条，不就可以看做是适应性强的特征吗？

en.t: Could not the single fact that there are many varieties be regarded as a sign of strong adaptability?

units.source_text: 这个发现让他高兴地蹦跳起来：“我的想法，并非不切实。”

en.t: This discovery made him jump for joy: "My idea is not impractical after all."

units.source_text: 所谓“适应性强”，指的就是别的昆虫无法居住的地方，有的昆虫却能安然居住。

en.t: What is called "strong adaptability" means that some insects can live safely in places where other insects cannot survive.

units.source_text: 譬如说，沙漠那种地方，一切生物都会死绝……

en.t: For example, in a place like the desert, all living things would die out...
